notes:
- The game has a name: K7: Lockdown. It's on the title screen, the window and the HUD. Your saves,
  levels and loadouts carry over.
- Photorealistic graphics:
  - World: every surface uses scanned materials (brick, concrete, tile, wood, metal...).
  - Props: they're now scanned 3D models.
  - Zombies: they're realistic people (13 kinds: inmates, guards, medics, townsfolk, hazmat, scientists)
    with rotting skin and bloody clothes. They still lose limbs and heads, and they ragdoll.
  - Guns: they have smooth, solid models.
  - Starter pistol: it's a fully scanned model.
  - Hands: your first-person hands and arms are realistic. Handguns are held with a proper two-handed
    grip, and your trigger finger pulls the trigger.
  - Not yet realistic: teammates, perk machines, the Mystery Box and Le Chonk come in later updates.
- Female body option in CUSTOMIZE > BODY: a female survivor (smaller frame, longer hair, same
  outfits and gear) with matching female first-person hands.
- Mystery Box moves. After 7 spins at one spot, each spin has a chance to show "BYE BYE". You get
  your points back, the box flies off and turns up somewhere else.
- New power-up: Fire Sale. For 30 seconds the Mystery Box costs 10 points and there's one at every
  box spot.
- Perks cost 1500, plus 500 for each perk you already have (1500, 2000, 2500, 3000).
- More Sir Chonks. Each Sir Chonk round brings one more than the last, so the 4th Le Chonk round has
  2 of them. They share one health bar.
- Overkill and Purge no longer kill Sir Chonk in one go.
- Melee weapons have levels and camos, like guns (LOADOUT > MELEE). They can also go in the upgrade
  machine: 3x damage and one more zombie per swing (Bloodletter, Home Run Hitter, Executioner, Muramasa).
- Gun levels: guns now go up to level 50, and they level up a bit more slowly.
- Camos unlock by gun level instead of player level: Woodland 3, Desert 6, Urban 10, Arctic 15,
  Crimson 20, Tiger 26, Gold 33, Diamond 40, Plasma 46, Dark Matter 50.
- Optics: iron sights on every gun, and optics are optional. The pistol's optic sits on the slide.
  The Longshot's scope is an attachment, fitted by default.
- Spectator camera: in co-op, after you bleed out you watch a teammate over their shoulder until the
  next round. Click to switch between teammates.
